scope: Static reading of primary texts and pinned repository trees. Nothing was built, executed or downloaded as data; no entry is a reproduction.

fields.provenance: AUTHOR | REIMPLEMENTED | PROXY | UNAVAILABLE — who wrote the artifact relative to the cited work
fields.paper_fidelity: UNKNOWN | KNOWN_DEVIATIONS | NOT_APPLICABLE — correspondence of the artifact to the published configuration
fields.license_status: CLEAR | UNRESOLVED | CONFLICT | NOT_APPLICABLE — permission to build, run and adapt the artifact in Delsk CI, including every vendored component on the build path; CLEAR requires project_license
fields.data_status: AVAILABLE | PARTIAL | WITHHELD | UNKNOWN | NOT_APPLICABLE — inputs, checkpoints and datasets the artifact needs
fields.reproduction_status: NOT_ATTEMPTED | PENDING | BLOCKED | VERIFIED — VERIFIED requires a GitHub Actions run URL in evidence
fields.comparator_readiness: NEEDS_ADAPTER | BLOCKED | NOT_A_COMPARATOR | NOT_APPLICABLE — readiness for the shared C_t / Top-K harness

work.title: DeepSketch: A New Machine Learning-Based Reference Search Technique for Post-Deduplication Delta Compression

artifacts.label: author platform
notes: Paper ref [1] github.com/dgist-datalab/deepsketch-fast2022 redirects to this repository; pinned commit is HEAD (2022-05-06).
No project license. Vendored xdelta3: Apache-2.0 LICENSE file, GPL-2.0-or-later headers in xdelta3.c/.h; COPYING and several autotools files are dangling symlinks to the authors' build host.
Sources include ../xxhash.h, which is absent from the tree.
Inference (deepsketch/deepsketch.h, multi_cand/deepsketch.h) hardcodes torch::kCUDA; no trained checkpoint is shipped. CPU use needs a documented deviation.
Paper footnote 4 promises open data; README publishes only the Stack Overflow pointer and defers other data for privacy.
Paper §5.1: GeForce RTX 2080 for DNN inference; §5.6: offline training under 4 hours.

work.title: SpeedSketch: An Ultra-Fast Sketch Generation and Delta Encoding Framework for Delta Compression

artifacts.label: author research implementation
notes: Root LICENSE is GPL-2.0, but license_status stays UNRESOLVED because of vendored components: xdelta3 repeats the Apache LICENSE / GPL header mismatch, and zdelta, edelta and a prebuilt lib/libzd.a have their own notices. The root Makefile (speedsketch binary) does not link them; odess/Makefile links -lzd.
README: FastCDC 4/8/32 KiB instead of the paper's 2/8/32 KiB; single-file simulator; payload estimate excludes indexes, recipes and container metadata.
Build documented: GNU Make, C++14/C99, pthread, zstd; make check and CLI tests exist. Not built in this pass.
No interface for an external candidate universe C_t or Top-K; the sketch and the sketch-accelerated encoder are coupled (ss-g-s), so encoder speedups must not be attributed to ranking quality.
Paper datasets are not shipped; README offers a 64 MiB synthetic feasibility fixture only.

artifacts.label: author Rust/Python implementation
notes: Paper links github.com/ds2lab/ZipLLM (HTTP 404); the code lives at ds2-lab/ZipLLM.
README: current version supports BF16 only; the paper describes BitX as data-type-agnostic and evaluates mainly BF16/FP32.
bitx_bytes.rs truncates to min(len1, len2) & !1: a model-track adapter must reject unequal or odd lengths and check dtype, shape, mapping and full target reconstruction.
Downloader defaults to revision=main (mutable); historical checkpoint availability, license and ancestry are per-model questions.
examples/bitx.rs compresses with 48 zstd threads; not a bounded Actions configuration.
License CLEAR covers this repository only, not models or datasets.

work.title: FastCDC: a Fast and Efficient Content-Defined Chunking Approach for Data Deduplication

artifacts.label: FastCDC-c
notes: Auxiliary chunker, not a reference-search comparator.
Only vendored component is uthash.h under a BSD-style notice, compatible with CLEAR.
Driver main() opens a hardcoded empty path and mallocs CacheSize = 1 GiB; a bounded driver and the exact chunking variant (USE_CHUNKING_METHOD) must be locked separately.
Paper not re-read section by section in this pass.
